message.content:
This is an upholstered seat with a wooden frame, which falls under heading 9401.61 (other seats, with wooden frames, upholstered). Seats with wooden frames that are not upholstered go to 9401.69, so upholstered is the right branch.

9401.61.40 covers "Other seats, with wooden frames, upholstered: Other" (the sub-breakdown is 9401.61.20 for seats of a kind used for the 9401.10... actually 9401.61.20 is "Seats of a kind used for aircraft" no). The structure is:
- 9401.61.20: Seats specially designed for motor vehicles (not applicable).
- 9401.61.40: Other, "Having a back and a seat of ..." (not recalled exactly).
- 9401.61.60: Other.

The current HTSUS has these subheadings:
- 9401.61.20: Seats of a kind used for aircraft.
- 9401.61.30: Of a kind used for motor vehicles.
- 9401.61.40: Other, "Theater seats / Other: Of bamboo"? Uncertain.
- 9401.61.60: Other.

I recall 9401.61.40 as "Other: Stacking chairs" (not applicable), 9401.61.60 as "Other: Other" (applicable). In the actual schedule I believe 9401.61.40 is "Other: Of wood... " but the common classification for upholstered wooden-framed sofas is 9401.61.6011 (Other, Other, Household). Many rulings for upholstered sofas with wood frames give 9401.61.6011.

The frame is bamboo, HDF, and poplar. Bamboo is not wood, but the HDF and poplar are wood, and rulings treat such frames as wooden frames. Heading 9401.61 therefore applies.
